title: 5.5 Likes, Dislikes, and Me Too
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Say what I like and do not like, ask Do you like ...?, and agree with Me too.
grammar_function: I like apples. I do not like fish. They like grapes. Do you like coffee? Yes, I do. I like coffee. Me too.
prerequisite: 3.2 I; 1.8 not; 4.8 Do you...?; 5.1-5.3 fruit, food and drinks.
speaking_outcome: Say what I like and do not like, and agree with Me too.
